Second starts after the flip are ignored in u2, matching 'at least once'. Reachability/compactness: in siren setups all four states are reachable (u0 initial, u1 on the ring, u2 on the flip, u3 at exit); u1/u2 being unreachable in no-siren setups is correct since the preference is vacuous there; four states is minimal for tracking pre-siren / ringing-untoggled / toggled / terminal. No regression transitions are needed: the preference is a one-shot event and no condition must be sustained across steps, so u2 correctly does not regress on a second ring. Minor notes (non-blocking): the !at_exit in (u0, siren_ringing & !at_exit) is redundant given transition ordering but harmless; the flat 1.0 exit reward rather than the environment's time-dependent payment is acceptable since the RM encodes the stated task and step pressure is the environment's own payout; predicate-only guards are used throughout with proper persistent/event distinction (siren_ringing persistent, switch_toggled as a one-step event trigger).
